name: Shun Ren
subtitle: Singapore-based security & software engineer
description: Shun Ren — Singapore-based security & software engineer. Projects, skills, and background.

paragraphs: Hello there. You can call me Shun.
I'm am aspiring cyber security programmer still paving my own path through the maze of programming languages.

Being a digital native, my gaze is always turned towards the future.However, I believe that just like in any other tide of change before it, in order for IT to thrive, we need a strong foundation of security.
I am now planning to take a CS degree with the intent to specialise in Networking and Cybersecurity.
